description: This PHP class 'ArrayMapper' provides functionality to map and transform arrays or objects according to specified mappings, regex mappings, and other configuration options. It is part of the SuiteCRM/CRM customization and utility tools.

classes.name: ArrayMapper
classes.description: A class for mapping arrays/objects with flexible configuration including static and regex mappings, blacklist filtering, and optional hiding of empty values.

methods.name: getMappings
methods.description: Returns the current mapping definitions used for key translation.

methods.name: setMappings
methods.description: Sets the mapping definitions for key translation and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: getMappable
methods.description: Returns the current array or object to be mapped.

methods.name: setMappable
methods.description: Sets the array or object to be mapped, validating the argument type.

methods.name: getRegexMappings
methods.description: Returns regex-based mappings.

methods.name: setRegexMappings
methods.description: Sets regex-based mappings.

methods.name: getBlacklist
methods.description: Returns the blacklist of paths to exclude from mapping.

methods.name: setBlacklist
methods.description: Sets the blacklist of paths to exclude.

methods.name: isHideEmptyValues
methods.description: Checks if empty values are hidden during mapping.

methods.name: setHideEmptyValues
methods.description: Sets whether to hide empty values during the mapping process.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new ArrayMapper with fluent interface.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Performs the mapping of the current mappable object/array based on configured mappings and options.

methods.name: loadYaml
methods.description: Loads configuration mappings from a YAML file.

methods.name: mapArray
methods.description: Recursively maps an array structure.

methods.name: mapObject
methods.description: Recursively maps an object.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main recursive method that processes each key-value pair.

methods.name: handleStructure
methods.description: Handles nested array or object structures.

methods.name: handleMap
methods.description: Handles mapping based on explicit mapping definitions.

methods.name: handleRegex
methods.description: Handles mapping based on regex pattern matches.

methods.name: handleDefault
methods.description: Handles default path mapping when no other rules apply.

methods.name: updatePath
methods.description: Updates current path stack with a new key.

methods.name: fixStringValue
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities within string values.

methods.name: shouldSkipEmpty
methods.description: Determines if a value should be skipped when empty.

methods.name: putInPath
methods.description: Sets a value at the specified path in the internal result array.

methods.name: appendInPath
methods.description: Appends a value to the array at the specified path.

methods.name: getArrayAtPath
methods.description: Returns a reference to the array at the specified path for insertion.

methods.name: isBlackListed
methods.description: Checks if a given path is in the blacklist.

methods.name: handleValue
methods.description: Handles placing a value into the mapped result, supporting append syntax.
